objective: Continue this rational-expansion research from its existing notes. Identify what is established, avoid repeating a falsified conjecture, and prove a useful next statement about which reduced rational numbers have terminating decimal expansions.

files.PROGRESS.md: Established: if q=2^a*5^b, every reduced p/q has a terminating decimal expansion, by scaling to a power of ten. Open: necessity for arbitrary q. Failed claim: every prime denominator gives a nonterminating expansion. Counterexample saved separately. Next possible mechanism: a terminating expansion implies q divides a power of ten; prove why reduction matters.
files.counterexample.txt: 1/2=0.5. Thus the unqualified prime-denominator claim is false.
